title: The Pale Harvest
journal: Nesh-Deeka sent me to the wreck of the Pale Harvest in Hatandros Bight, a short swim out from Ysan's jetty. I'm to get into the hold, where the drowned crew walk, and open the captain's strongbox. I may fight them or steal past and pick its lock; the captain carries its key.
objectives: Open the captain's strongbox in the wreck of the Pale Harvest. (marker: Captain's Strongbox, Drowned Captain, Ysan Jetty)

plan.going: The silver setting named the Pale Harvest, a wreck that may hold the next clue to the Eye.
plan.next: Travel by boat to Thorn, walk to Ysan's jetty, swim to the wreck and open the captain's strongbox.
plan.ways: Fight the drowned crew and take the captain's key, or sneak past them and pick the strongbox's Adept lock.
terms: Hatandros Bight and Ysan: journal 10: the bay, and the landing with the stone jetty

answers: I am a Voh-Vastei of the Toh-Reel-Ka under Nesh-Deeka. The Pale Harvest, a Company freighter, sank in Hatandros Bight with a dealers stock aboard; it is the next lead to the real Eye of Argonia, which is meant to heal the Hist trees at the Root. The Unbound and the Collector (Ennodius Vanin) also hunt the Eye.
Get into the wreck of the Pale Harvest (a short swim from Ysan jetty), get past the drowned crew in the hold, and open the captain's strongbox.
Fight the drowned crew and take the key from the Drowned Captain, or sneak past and pick the strongbox lock.
I do not know what is in the strongbox or exactly what the drowned crew are; I will find out by looking inside the wreck.

title: The Pale Harvest
journal: In the captain's strongbox lay a keystone on a chain, carved in a style I do not know. I'm to bring it to Nesh-Deeka in her house in Helstrom.
objectives: Bring the keystone to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: I have a keystone from the wreck; I do not know what it opens.
plan.next: Bring it to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom, by boat back up the rivers.

answers: I killed the drowned sailor and captain, took the key and opened the strongbox on the Pale Harvest. It held a Kothringi Keystone on a chain, not the Eye itself, but presumably a further lead.
Bring the keystone to Nesh-Deeka in her house in Helstrom.
I can go straight to Nesh-Deeka; I do not see another option, though I could study the keystone first.
I do not know what a Kothringi Keystone is or what the Kothringi style means. Nesh-Deeka may explain.

title: The Pale Harvest
journal: Nesh-Deeka did not know the keystone, but it is of Kothringi make (the Kothringi were the silver-skinned people of the marsh, all dead of the Knahaten Flu long ago), and the Chime-Keepers of Toklea keep what is left of Kothringi lore. She already knew the Unbound had not found the wreck. When I asked how, she said "we listen" and talked of Toklea instead. She paid me 100 gold.

plan.going: The keystone is Kothringi; the Chime-Keepers of Toklea may know what it opens. Nesh-Deeka again knew where the Unbound had or had not been.
plan.next: MN08 starts; its first entry marks Toklea.
terms: Kothringi: Nesh-Deeka: the silver-skinned people of the marsh, dead of the Knahaten Flu
the Chime-Keepers of Toklea: Nesh-Deeka: the town that keeps Kothringi lore

answers: The Pale Harvest quest is done. I got the Kothringi Keystone from the wreck and Nesh-Deeka paid 100 gold. She did not know the keystone but says the carving is Kothringi, and the Chime-Keepers of Toklea keep Kothringi lore. It is another step toward the Eye of Argonia, which should heal the Hist trees at the Root.
Nothing is set yet. The obvious next lead is Toklea, a town on the river fork in the Tulmek Washes, where the elder in the old Kothringi greathouse should know the keystone.
Go to Toklea and ask the elder, or ask Nesh-Deeka more. I still carry the keystone.

Nesh-Deeka still will not say how she knew the Unbound had not been to the wreck ("we listen"), and that is suspicious. I do not know what the keystone opens or does. The Chime-Keepers elder may tell me.
